verdict.rationale: Retell's official quick start promises a first phone agent in 15 minutes. It covers creating an account, picking or generating an agent from a prompt, choosing a voice in basic settings, testing via a free web call, assigning the agent to a phone number and making a call, with $10 of free trial credits. That covers prompt, voice, phone number and a live call well within an hour. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the setup-time claim, and detail on acquiring the phone number (purchase step and cost) beyond assigning the agent to it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a working phone voice agent — prompt, voice, and phone number — and take my first live call within an hour

citations.quote: Build your first Retell AI phone agent in 15 minutes: create an account, pick a template, test in the dashboard, deploy to a phone number, and make a call.
click **Generate from prompt** (marked Suggested) to let [Conductor](/conductor/create-agent) draft an agent from a plain-English description of your use case
Three settings decide how your agent sounds and behaves before you write a word of prompt: the language model, the voice, and who speaks first.
Assign your agent to the number in the configuration settings
New accounts start with \$10 in free trial credits, no payment method required.
